schema.title: Response Mine Api V1 Rfqs Get

post.description:
Queue reminders for one, selected or all pending suppliers; report every outcome.

Body: ``{}`` or no body = every pending supplier; ``{"invitation_ids": [...]}`` or
``{"supplier_org_ids": [...]}`` = those suppliers. Pending means the persisted
matching result (same query as the buyer page): an active invitation of a matched
supplier without a submitted quotation. Each supplier invitation has its own
cooldown. Suppliers without a usable contact are skipped, never silently counted.
Messages are queued durable outbox events; delivery is reported by the provider later.
Private development attachments; production waits for storage/scanning integration.

get.description:
Explain classification, Material Master resolution, evidence levels, exclusions, jobs and delivery to admins.

post.description:
Re-run matching for a published RFQ without recreating it.

Existing matches are re-evaluated in place, invitations stay unique per supplier
(uq_invitation), and quotations and supplier responses are never modified.

schema.title: Response Outbox Api V1 Notifications Admin Outbox Get

post.description: An admin confirmed the address is valid again (e.g. mailbox restored). History kept.

Replace a bounced supplier email in that supplier's records and optionally resend.

Only records of the delivery's supplier organization holding the bounced address are
changed (contact channels, legacy contact email, business email). Nothing is deleted.

Signed provider delivery/bounce events (HMAC-SHA256, see bounces.verify_webhook).

Headers: ``X-Procura-Timestamp`` (unix seconds) and ``X-Procura-Signature``
(``sha256=<hex HMAC of "<timestamp>.<raw body>">``). Body: ``{"events": [{"id",
"type", "message_id", "delivery_id", "recipient", "status", "diagnostic"}]}``.

schema.title: Response List Inquiries Api V1 Contact Admin Inquiries Get

post.description: Split a plain list into lines and classify each: Discipline, Main Category, Subcategory, Material, Brand.
Queue one fresh consolidated notification (new magic link) for an invited supplier.
Email a client-format PDF to the counterparty's business email or to the requesting user.
Safely requeue matching for a published RFQ (existing scripts.requeue_rfq_matching logic; no deletes).
The supplier's explicit approval is what submits the quotation to the buyer.
Exchange a magic-link token for a restricted, HttpOnly portal session.
Send a one-time code to the email/phone this link was delivered to.
Binding submission: explicit confirmation + verified recipient + real prices only.
Generate a PDF in the client's format. Requires no account; nothing is stored.

Delivery reports pushed by SMS Gateway for Android (sms:sent / sms:delivered / sms:failed).

Authenticated by the provider's HMAC signature, not by a user session. It only updates
the delivery state of an SMS this platform already submitted (matched by provider
message id); it can never create or resubmit a message. Status polling remains the
fallback when webhooks are not configured or not delivered.
